evidence.baseline: relational health indicators (the quality and depth of the relationships within and between communities, measured through participant experience rather than through behavioral proxies); developmental progress indicators ...; ecological health indicators ...; and constitutional fidelity indicators (the degree to which the governance mechanisms are functioning as designed, measured through governance process audits rather than through outcome metrics that can be gamed)

findings.diagnosis: Each parenthesis says what the indicator measures and by what method, and in two cases names the method it must not use. Those exclusions are the anti-Goodhart design the paragraph before it argues for, so removing them leaves the chapter arguing for gaming resistance and then listing four gameable names.

findings.summary: The argument that human judgment is a feature was cut to an assertion.

evidence.baseline: This is a feature rather than a defect. The measurement of what Providence actually values requires the kind of engaged human attention that automated systems cannot provide, and the practice of that engaged attention is itself a development of the capacities Providence is trying to cultivate.

findings.diagnosis: The closing move, that the act of measuring develops the thing being measured, is the only thing that distinguishes this measurement proposal from every other dashboard. It also anticipates Chapter Twenty-Six's argument that presence is infrastructure, which is the volume's closing turn.

findings.summary: Credit, running the other way. The kept bounding earns the universal the baseline overclaims.

openQuestions: The volume-04 voice card was prepared by the same pass that produced the shipped text, and its exemplar anchors and protected lines quote that text rather than the baseline. The card records `Author approved: pending tone, strategy, heading, and overcompression review`. The restoration keeps every line the card protects and otherwise follows the baseline, which means card and source now diverge in wording the card does not name. R-VOICE-BIND requires that the disagreement be raised rather than settled here: the card should be re-derived from whichever text the author approves.

Structural labels were frozen for this pass and none was touched. Every markdown heading, every standalone bold display line, every chapter label, and every all-capital display line is byte identical to its pre-edit state, in the same order, with the same blank-line separators on both sides. A label determines a section id, a section id is a public route, and `publishing/continuity/section-lineage.json` already records this volume's renames and resolves the historical routes. Changing one is a continuity decision and not an editorial one. Only the running prose between labels was restored. Where a baseline label names its section better than the current one, the cost is recorded here and the label is left alone.

substitutionTest.rule: R-CAUTIOUS-HALF, substitution form, run as standing procedure before any pairing test
substitutionTest.method: Normalize both texts, strip markup, split into sentences of three or more words, count baseline sentences appearing verbatim in the current section.
substitutionTest.note: Well above zero, so the section is a restoration, not a substitution, and the pairing test applies. Verbatim survival understates fidelity here: every R-PUNCT-STRUCT repair and recorded bounding changes the sentence it lands in, so the non-surviving remainder was read against the diff and attributed rather than assumed lost.

audits.checked: R-CAUTIOUS-HALF: the Goodhart sentence keeps both its bounding half, structurally likely, and its committing half, the instruction to design measurement systems resistant to Goodharting; the human-judgment argument keeps its committing close that judgment grounded in relationship is among the capacities Providence is trying to cultivate. R-PAIRED-DELETION: Goodhart's Law and the four indicator families were swept; Goodhart appears once in the corpus baseline for this volume and once in the current text, both here, so no cross-section end exists to break. R-CORRECTION-SCOPE: no recorded correction reaches this body; the structurally likely bounding is the prior pass's own repair, credited below rather than treated as a correction. R-LEDGER-WINS-COROLLARY: nothing seeded. R-SUBSTITUTION-CREDIT: one kept-on-merits repair converted to a credit finding, F3. R-CANON-DELETION-RECORD: nothing cut. CTD-0006 re-verified: the four restored indicator families are relational, developmental, ecological, and constitutional, none physiological. R-REFRAIN-COST, R-TENSE, R-DEIXIS, R-NEGATION-STACK: nothing fires.
audits.conclusion: The restoration holds under the full twenty-rule index. Seven of eleven baseline sentences survive verbatim; the remainder are the recorded punctuation repairs, the parenthesis conversions and diction normalization attributed below, and the credited Goodhart bounding. No prose change required.
corrections: One unitemized punctuation repair now attributed: the opening paragraph's appositive pair around its examination of how GDP, engagement metrics, and other dominant measures systematically discount regenerative value was an em dash pair in the baseline and stands as a comma pair, consistent with R-PUNCT-STRUCT. The original record itemized two repairs; the section carried six glyphs across three sites.

The four parenthetical indicator definitions stand as comma appositives inside the semicolon list, and the enumerating colon after include was dropped. Parentheses are not prohibited marks, so this was normalization rather than required repair. Kept: the definitions are load-bearing, and section 3 reserves parentheses for genuinely incidental material. A serial and before governance wisdom completes the recorded appositive rebuild.

The baseline's a feature rather than a bug stands as a feature rather than a defect, an unitemized diction normalization. Kept under R-REGISTER-DICTION: equal precision, and the volume's constitutional register over a software idiom. Claim unchanged.
